page.layout: One title page, printed upside down on the scan. Title block at the top, a woodcut device (anchor with a serpent) in the centre, imprint at the foot. No margins.
page.notes: The page is printed upside down, so the lines are transcribed in the order they read when the page is turned. Much of the title is faint and set in spaced capitals, and several lines could not be read with certainty; they are marked [?] or illegible. The woodcut device shows an anchor entwined with a serpent and is not transcribed. The imprint year is read as M.D.LXXVI with doubt.

main_text.l: CATHOLICO [?] Q V A T V O R
